==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
*This unit has the same range as [[Dragon Knight (Gauntlet)]] making both of them units with the 2nd biggest range in the game; [[Green Alien (Nameless)]] and [[Somber (Buzzsaw)]] being 1st. Only [[Lulu]] (no range limit) has bigger range.
